provenance.title: Hopf solitons in the Nicole model

candidates.statement: This should help in understanding the properties of Hopf solitons in theories constructed from more conventional terms.
candidates.section_title: The Nicole model and volume-preserving flow

candidates.statement: It is easy to prove that the volume-preserving flow ([\[vpgf\]](#vpgf){reference-type="ref" reference="vpgf"}) indeed preserves the volume $V$ and reduces the energy $E$: the proof is a simple modification of that presented in [@GS] but the result should be obvious from the geometrical aspect of its construction.
candidates.section_title: The Nicole model and volume-preserving flow

candidates.statement: In section [\[sec-num\]](#sec-num){reference-type="ref" reference="sec-num"} we shall present results for a scheme using fourth-order accurate finite difference approximations to spatial derivatives on a cubic lattice consisting of $151^3$ points with unit lattice spacing (taking advantage of the scale invariance of the continuum problem in $\hbox{\mybb R}^3$).
